email.subject1: a signal play for Remodel Health
email.body1:
Reid, saw Remodel Health raised over 100M from Oak HC/FT and ICHRA revenue is running at double last year heading into 2026.

Growing direct sales that fast usually means more in-market employers in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remodel Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Reid, quick follow-up for Remodel Health.

After a raise, the growth target on direct sales usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Remodel Health needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Reid, last bit of proof for Remodel Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Remodel Health reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Reid, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling direct sales without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a direct-sales motion? I will tailor it to Remodel Health either way.
